name: Ideogram
tagline: Create AI images with text, then refine the typography in editable layers.
description: Ideogram generates images from prompts with a focus on designs that include text. You can describe the words, typography, and placement needed for a poster, cover, or social graphic. Its Layerize Text feature turns text in a generated design into editable components so you can revise wording, fonts, or size without generating the whole image again.

features.label: Text within generated images
features.text: Include specific words and typographic instructions in a prompt to create text as part of the visual composition.

features.label: Editable text layers
features.text: Layerize Text extracts text into selectable components for changes to wording, font, and size.

features.label: Design-oriented generation
features.text: Use design categories and prompts suited to posters, book covers, social graphics, and other text-led formats.

useCases.label: Develop a poster or cover
useCases.text: Explore visual concepts that combine a headline with an illustration or other generated imagery.

useCases.label: Revise marketing graphics
useCases.text: Generate a concept, then edit its headline or typography with text layers as the message changes.

limitations: Images are published by default. Private generation and image deletion require eligible paid plans.
Some AI editing and reference features require priority credits and are unavailable in the slow queue.
Text rendering support varies by script; the official guide emphasizes English and other Latin-script languages.
guide.pricingNote: Ideogram has a Free plan for eligible accounts and paid subscriptions. Credits, queues, privacy, and editing access vary; check the official plan details.

faqs.question: Can Ideogram generate text inside an image?
faqs.answer: Yes. Text rendering is a core feature. Specify the words, type style, and placement in your prompt, and inspect the resulting design before publishing it.

faqs.question: Can I change the text after an Ideogram image is generated?
faqs.answer: Layerize Text creates editable text components so you can change wording, fonts, or size without regenerating the entire design.

seo.description: Ideogram creates AI images with text for posters, covers, and social graphics. Refine wording, fonts, and size with its editable text layers.
